sentence: This project builds a tool that uses data from a wristwatch and a cell phone to detect falls in elderly people.
This project tries to find out whether the mucus that jellyfish make helps them spread and thrive in warm environments.
This project makes network traffic datasets available to researchers who study cybersecurity and network attacks.
This project studies how metal particles turn light into heat and measures temperature differences between the particle and its surroundings.
This project uses natural language processing and machine learning to find how the way graphene oxide is made affects its properties.
This project studies how mountain snow extremes are changing over time and how often conditions swing from one extreme to the other.
This project studies how frog skin has evolved and how it affects breathing and water loss as the climate changes.
This project brings experts from many fields together to find out how a few cases of an infectious disease grow into a pandemic.
This project studies how floods and landslides from a hurricane changed the genetic makeup of freshwater fish.
This project builds a machine learning tool that finds forming exoplanets in protoplanetary disks and measures their mass.
This project uses genomic and morphological data to trace how a group of scorpions evolved and to revise how they are classified.
This project uses computer simulations to study how magnetic particles can control the way fluid droplets and interfaces form in emulsions.
This project tries to make thin film semiconductor alloys of high crystal quality for detecting infrared light.
This project holds a workshop where colleges share practices on cyberinfrastructure, cybersecurity and connectivity.
This project builds an observatory and dashboard that check whether internet routing policies on research and education networks are correct and effective.
